definitions.frequency_score: 0-100 = 50 x (share of the last 12 weeks with >=1 human commit) + 50 x min(1, log10(1+commits in 12w)/log10(301)) across the project's main repos (default branches, bots excluded).
definitions.silence: days since the most recent human commit on any main repo default branch; flags at 14/30/60 days. "previously_active" = >=10 commits in the 90 days before the last commit. Backtest uses ONSET weeks (first week crossing the threshold) of previously active projects.
definitions.burst: week commits >=5 and (>=3x the trailing 8-week average, or trailing avg 0, or z>2.5 vs trailing 12 weeks). Backtest de-duplicates bursts within 4 weeks per project. Live: rolling last 7 days vs the 8/12 prior 7-day blocks.
definitions.returns: log(price[t+h]/price[t]) - log(BTC[t+h]/BTC[t]) using CoinGecko free daily closes (365-day window) from the Monday 00:00 UTC that ends the signal week; percent figures convert the log value back (exp-1).
definitions.tests: Fisher exact (hit rate vs base rate), Mann-Whitney U (normal approx, two-sided) + Cliff's delta on the excess-return distributions, and a project-clustered permutation test (each event is replaced by a random week of the SAME project) for the mean. Overlapping weekly horizons make naive p-values optimistic; trust the clustered one most.
caveats: Repo set is today's (main repos chosen now) - survivorship/look-ahead in repo choice.
Price history is only ~365 days (free CoinGecko), so the backtest spans ~Oct 2025-Oct 2026 minus the horizon.
Commit counts measure activity, not quality; monorepo vs many-repo projects differ in scale (z/burst are within-project).
Shallow-since clones count commits reachable from the default branch only; squash-merge projects show fewer commits.
